construct: Methotrexate competitively inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, preventing regeneration of tetrahydrofolate and thereby limiting one-carbon transfer reactions needed for thymidylate and purine synthesis. Leucovorin is a reduced folate that bypasses the blocked DHFR step and rescues normal cells after high-dose therapy.
